1646: // readBuildEnvSources reads a build's ordered env Secret sources (envFromSources
1647: // of the in-flight release) into one map, later sources winning — the runtime
1648: // envFrom precedence. A missing optional group Secret contributes nothing; any
1649: // other read failure, including the service's own Secret missing, fails the
1650: // build rather than building with a partial environment.
1651: func (r *AppReconciler) readBuildEnvSources(ctx context.Context, app *appv1alpha1.App, sources []corev1.EnvFromSource) (map[string][]byte, error) {
1652: 	refs := make([]buildSecretSource, 0, len(sources))
1653: 	for _, source := range sources {
1654: 		ref := source.SecretRef
1655: 		refs = append(refs, buildSecretSource{name: ref.Name, optional: ref.Optional != nil && *ref.Optional})
1656: 	}
1657: 	return r.readBuildSecretSources(ctx, app, "env", refs)
1658: }
